parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Differentiate to obtain $kx^2(2x^3+10)^{-1/2}$ — M1. Or unsimplified equivalent.
$3x^2(2x^3+10)^{-1/2}$ — A1. Or unsimplified equivalent.
Substitute $x=3$ in first derivative and evaluate gradient — M1*. Expect $27/8$; allow if first derivative has form $k(2x^3+10)^{-1/2}$, $kx(2x^3+10)^{-1/2}$ or $kx^2(2x^3+10)^{1/2}$.
Attempt tangent equation at $(3,8)$ with numerical gradient — DM1. Use of gradient of normal is DM0.
$27x-8y-17=0$, or integer multiples — A1.
Total: 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State or imply volume is $\pi\int(2x^3+10)\,dx$ — B1. Implied if $\pi$ appears only at end; do not allow an unsimplified $\pi\int(\sqrt{2x^3+10})^2$.
Integrate to obtain $k_1x^4+k_2x$ and evaluate with limits 1 and 3, where $k_1,k_2\neq0$ — M1.
$60\pi$ — A1. OE; allow from a correct integral and sight of limits; allow numerical answers 188–189.
Total: 3.
